resources.string: Watching per-app network use on this phone — nothing uploaded. Works beside your VPN.
All on this phone. No cloud upload. Works beside a real VPN. Not antivirus. No HTTPS decrypt.

Usage Access lets WireLens show which apps use the network (bytes in/out and rate). Destinations/IPs are not available in this mode — that would require taking Android’s single VPN slot, which would break commercial VPNs. We choose coexistence. Heuristics (sudden busy, high background) are hints only — not malware. HTTPS is never decrypted.
Monitor on with your VPN — %1$d apps · coexistence mode
Turn on Usage Access for WireLens, then tap Start again.
Open Settings → Apps → Special access → Usage access, enable WireLens.
